facts.fact: The consolidated text of the National Payment Systems Act 2018 (Act 17 of 2018) lists amendments in force through Act 3 of 2026 (18 April 2026), and makes the Bank of Mauritius regulator of national payment systems, with power to issue binding directives and guidelines (s.4, s.17).

Section 9(1) of the National Payment Systems Act 2018 (Act 17 of 2018) provides that no person other than the central bank or a bank may act as a payment service provider without a licence from the Bank of Mauritius, and s.2 and s.45 cover electronic money and mobile payment systems; the consolidated text runs through amendments to April 2026.
